messages:
Sasha M: heads up — p95 on pool-gamma jumped from ~45ms to ~230ms starting 09:12 UTC. spikes correlate with chat-lite tenant ramp.
Incidents Bot: INCIDENT CREATED #INC-2026-1726543210: latency spike on pool-gamma — paging eng-runtime oncall.
Kevin L: looking now. flameprof samples show a lot more time in attention_dispatch() after 09:12 — kernel selection switched to `tiling-32-slowpath` for short seqs.
Maria G: @Kevin any config changes pushed around that time? autoswitch rollout?
Kevin L: no infra pushes. but runtime logs show autoswitch heuristic flipped for ~12% of requests from that tenant — they have lots of short sequences (<=16) and our selector picked tiling-32 because of a recent metric update.
Derek T: that kernel has pathological per-token overhead for short batches. combined with our batching heuristic (min-batch 8 -> wait) we got smaller batches + expensive kernel = p95 blowup.
Sasha M: ok mitigation options — immediate: throttle chat-lite to reduce noisy neighbor effect; rollback selector tweak via feature flag; route chat-lite to fallback pool with older kernel; enable per-tenant batching override. which is fastest?
Shawn P: fastest is feature-flag rollback for autoswitch. second fastest is temporary tenant rate limit. routing requires routing-table sync and could take ~10m.
Kevin L: I can flip flag: `runtime.kernel.autoswitch=v1` for pool-gamma. curl to flags service:
```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/set -d '{"flag":"runtime.kernel.autoswitch","value":"v1","scope":"pool-gamma"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
Kevin L: flipping now.
Incidents Bot: ACTION: feature flag update submitted by Kevin L (tx id 0x9f3a).
Maria G: while that propagates, I'll put a temporary rate-limit on chat-lite at 70rps via quota service.
Derek T: adding a small KV warmup for that tenant would help cold-cache misses — but that's a medium-term step. can we also enable `kvcache.prefetch=true` for chat-lite?
Kevin L: flag flip finished. monitoring... p95 dropping towards baseline. nice.
Sasha M: great. Derek — can you open a follow-up to run a targeted perf test with synthetic short sequences to replicate selector decision surface? we need a better heuristic (seq-aware + tenant-weighted) and a backoff to avoid flip-flopping.
Derek T: on it. I'll include flameprof diffs, kernel timers, and a small script to reproduce. ticket: ENGRT-1427.
Shawn P: I'll update runbooks: add step to prefer older low-overhead kernel for seq<=32 when batch<12 until autoswitch V2 lands.
Maria G: comms: I'll post a brief note in #customer-facing after SOC review. mention transient latency for chat-lite, mitigated.
Sasha M: closing incident in 15m if stable. good work. :thumbsup:
